[4:53PM] #Iponri #TrafficUpdate 

The operatives of Light Up Lagos are currently carrying out maintenance work on the streetlights at Iponri. Their service truck occupies one lane along the main carriageway, resulting in slow vehicular movement for motorists heading towards the National Stadium. Consequently, the traffic backlog has extended to Eko Bridge and beyond. Our officers remain actively on ground and are visibly managing the situation to ease the flow of traffic.

#FollowLASTMA
